 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 ✨ Wisdom Fox & Fierce Tiger Dual Pendant Combo with Velore Chain

A powerful expression of mindset and style—this Wisdom Fox & Fierce Tiger Dual Pendant Combo from Studd Muffyn is crafted for individuals who carry both wisdom and strength in their journey.

This premium set features two 24K gold plated symbolic pendants:

The Wisdom Fox Pendant represents intelligence, sharp thinking, and clarity in decision-making. On the back, it is infused with Black Obsidian crystal using resin, known for its grounding and protective energy. It is designed for those who lead with strategy, awareness, and smart vision.

The Fierce Tiger Pendant symbolizes courage, raw strength, and fearless leadership. On the back, it is infused with Tiger Eye crystal using resin, known for confidence, focus, and personal power. It reflects bold action, confidence, and the ability to stand strong in every situation.

Both pendants are paired with a luxurious Velore Chain (24K Gold Plated), designed with a smooth, refined finish that enhances the elegance of the entire set while making it perfect for everyday premium wear.

💎 Core Representation

This combo represents Intelligence, Courage, Leadership & Strength — a perfect harmony of mind, power, and influence.

⚠️ Disclaimer:

Each piece is carefully crafted; slight variations may occur. Store away from water, perfume, and chemicals to maintain shine and quality.

 Crafted With
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 ♦ Black Obsidian (Back Infused) – Resin-infused in Wisdom Fox Pendant for protection, grounding, and negativity shielding energy.

♦ Tiger Eye (Back Infused) – Resin-infused in Fierce Tiger Pendant for confidence, focus, and personal power energy.

♦ 24K Gold Plated Alloy – Used for both pendants for premium shine, durability, and luxury finish.

♦ 24K Gold Plated Velore Chain – High-quality chain with smooth texture and elegant appearance.

♦ Jewellery Base Alloy – Strong metal base used for structure and long-lasting wear.

♦ Protective Resin Layer – Seals and holds crystal infusion securely at the back of each pendant.

 Benefits
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 • Intelligence Energy – Fox pendant supports clarity, smart thinking, and better decision-making.

• Courage Boost – Tiger pendant inspires confidence, fearlessness, and bold action.

• Leadership Vibe – Represents strong presence, authority, and influence.

• Balanced Energy – Combines mind (Fox) and power (Tiger) for complete personality strength.

• Premium Daily Wear – Velore Chain adds luxury, shine, and everyday elegance.

• Versatile Styling – Can be worn together or separately for different looks.

• Unisex Appeal – Designed for both men and women.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What does this combo include?

It includes 2 pendants (Fox & Tiger) and 1 Velore Chain.

Q2. What is special about this combo?

It represents Intelligence, Courage, Leadership & Strength in one powerful set.

Q3. What is the chain material?

The Velore Chain is 24K Gold Plated with a premium smooth finish.

Yes, you can wear them together or separately depending on your style.

Yes, it is lightweight and designed for comfortable everyday use.

Yes, it is suitable for both men and women.

Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and chemicals to maintain shine and finish.
